messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: Arcadia Imaging (dedicated pool arcadia-usw2) p99 latency > 8s for last 5m. p95 ~ 1.8s. Impacting inference/summary endpoints. Paging lisa_oncall.

lisa_oncall: ack. paging now, joining.

mike_sre: on it. grabbing traces from perf-trace. any customer notes from cs/account?

anna_cs: Arcadia Ops is on call, reported doctors saw timeouts in portal. They said issue started ~20:10 UTC and intermittently spikes.

arcadia_ops: we can confirm — batches failing, lots of 504s from our side. This is high priority for clinical dashboards.

lisa_oncall: assigning roles — mike/SRE lead, sophie/runtime for model fallback, raj for pool scaling, anna for comms, tom/account for contract SLA visibility.

sophie_runtime: looking at runtime metrics: GPU utilization on pool nodes ~92%, KV cache hit stable ~85%, but token service queue depth spikes. Also seeing a sharp rise in tail latencies on model variant rtx-q8_7b.

raj_engineer: checking autoscaling logs — dedicated group arcadia-usw2 did not scale beyond min=3 due to cooldown config. cooldown set to 10m. spike pattern is 2-3m bursts.

mike_sre: traces show request queueing inside frontend balancer before hitting pool. backend latencies per-request still okay when served. Looks like ingress burst + small pool size.

sophie_runtime: agreed. immediate mitigation options: 1) temporarily increase pool size to 6, 2) enable fallback to quantized model variant on overflow, 3) route a fraction traffic to warm spare in us-east-1. Which do we want now?

lisa_oncall: do 1+2 now. raj, scale. sophie, enable fallback. mike, start throttling rules for heavy tenants if needed.

raj_engineer: running scale command:```sh
redwood ctl dedicated scale --pool arcadia-usw2 --count 6 --reason "p99 surge"
```
(reacted :rocket: by lisa_oncall)

raj_engineer: API returned accepted, nodes provisioning. ETA ~180s.

sophie_runtime: enabling overflow fallback policy:```json
{"policy":"overflow_fallback","target_variant":"rtx-q4f-7b-fallback","threshold_p99_ms":2000}
```
activated. routing rule in place, keeps original unless queue_depth>200.

mike_sre: adding tenant-rate-limit for arcadia to 50rps to reduce burstiness while scaling finishes. Command:```sh
redwood policy set-rate-limit --tenant arcadia --region us-west-2 --rps 50 --duration 15m --note "mitigate p99 spikes"
```

(reacted :eyes: by arcadia_ops)

arcadia_ops: 50rps is fine for now, thanks. Please keep us updated on failover.

tom_account: flagging SLA implication — if we exceed 5m remediation we'll need an incident RFO for the support plan. Keeping legal in the loop.

anna_cs: I told Arcadia support channel that we're scaling and applying measures, they'll hold clinical ops off until stable.

mike_sre: new metrics: after scaling request, average queue depth dropped from 320 -> 60 in ~3m. p99 dropped from 8.2s -> 3.1s. still above SLO (2s).

sophie_runtime: we see 30% of traffic now served by fallback variant; fallback has slightly lower accuracy but still acceptable for summaries. p99 now ~1.9s on fallback path.

lisa_oncall: nice. keep fallback enabled for at least 30m and monitor. raj, once nodes fully provisioned, we can pull fallback back to default route gradually.

raj_engineer: nodes are online. increasing target pool to 8 per late-minute forecast:```sh
redwood ctl dedicated scale --pool arcadia-usw2 --count 8 --reason "forecasted sustained traffic after spike"
```

(reacted :thumbsup: by sophie_runtime)

mike_sre: setting a short-term routing policy to drain new nodes gracefully and rebalance. Also running a KV cache warm on new nodes to avoid cold-start latency.

sophie_runtime: turning off fallback for 10% of traffic to validate accuracy before full rollback:```sh
redwood routing update --tenant arcadia --region us-west-2 --fallback-weight 10
```

mike_sre: observation: one networking NIC on node-3 had transient packet drops around spike time — raising ticket to infra to check NIC firmware/driver. Will link net logs.

raj_engineer: infra ticket created: INF-14577. Node-3 will be replaced during next maintenance window; not needed for current availability.

arcadia_ops: latencies back to normal from our side. No timeouts for last 4m. We'll escalate to clinicians to resume. Thanks team.

lisa_oncall: good. next steps: 1) keep elevated pool at 8 for 2h, 2) keep fallback policy available for 30m, 3) infra to investigate NIC and report, 4) post-incident follow-up + RFO if remediation > 5m.

anna_cs: I'll coordinate customer postmortem and share timeline with Arcadia.

tom_account: I have finance and legal on standby if SLA credit request comes in.

mike_sre: logging incident timeline and saving traces: log saved at /var/incidents/2148765432/trace-archive.tar.gz

lisa_oncall: great job. closing warroom in 10m unless any regressions. react here if any new issues. :white_check_mark:

arcadia_ops: thanks everyone. we'll ping if anything else. (reacted :heart:)
